initialExam.title: State Police Sub-Inspector 2026
initialExam.description: State-level Sub-Inspector recruitment conducted by various state police recruitment boards across India.
initialExam.syllabus: General Knowledge, Current Affairs, Reasoning, Quantitative Aptitude, English/Hindi, State-specific GK.
initialExam.examPattern: Written exam (varies by state) + Physical Test + Interview/Document Verification.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Written Exam → Physical Test → Medical → Document Verification
initialExam.jobRole: Sub-Inspector in respective state police force
initialExam.careerGrowth: SI → Inspector → DSP → SP through promotions and state PSC.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit respective state police website 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Uniform Allowance, State-specific allowances, Medical
